entry.en: Your passport must expire more than 3 months after your arrival date to enter Belize.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe vencer más de 3 meses después de tu llegada para entrar a Belice.
entry.quote: To enter Belize, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ more than 3 months after the date you arrive.

entry.en: Paper declarations are still accepted, but Belizean authorities recommend completing the digital form before travel.
entry.es: Las declaraciones en papel aún se aceptan, pero las autoridades beliceñas recomiendan completar el formulario digital antes del viaje.
entry.quote: Whilst paper declarations will still be accepted during the phased transition to a fully digital system, the Belizean authorities recommend completing the digital form prior to travel.

entry.en: Leaving Belize by land or by water to Guatemala or Mexico requires a departure tax of 40 Belize dollars or 20 US dollars at the border.
entry.es: Salir de Belice por tierra o por agua hacia Guatemala o México exige pagar una tasa de salida de 40 dólares beliceños o 20 dólares estadounidenses en la frontera.
entry.quote: If you leave Belize by land, or by water crossing to Guatemala or Mexico, you must pay a departure tax of 40 Belize dollars or 20 US dollars at the border.

entry.en: Children aged 17 and under travelling alone or with a non-parent adult must carry a notarised letter proving parental responsibility or consent.
entry.es: Los menores de 17 años o menos que viajen solos o con un adulto que no sea su padre o madre deben llevar una carta notariada que acredite la responsabilidad parental o el consentimiento.
entry.quote: Children aged 17 and under who are travelling on their own, or with an adult who is not their parent, must carry a notarised letter to prove parental responsibility, or consent to travel from the parent or guardian.

entry.en: All visitors are required to have sufficient funds of US$75 per day and the documents required for their next destination.
entry.es: Todos los visitantes deben tener fondos suficientes de 75 dólares estadounidenses por día y los documentos requeridos para su próximo destino.
entry.quote: All visitors are required to have sufficient funds of US$75 per day and the documents required for their next destination.

entry.en: You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.
entry.es: Debes declarar todo lo que pueda estar prohibido o sujeto a impuestos o aranceles.
entry.quote: You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.

safety.en: Belize has one of the highest per capita murder rates in the world.
safety.es: Belice tiene una de las tasas de homicidios per cápita más altas del mundo.
safety.quote: Belize has one of the highest per capita murder rates in the world.

safety.en: Serious gang-related violence occurs most frequently in Belize City, particularly south of Haulover Creek (Southside).
safety.es: La violencia grave relacionada con pandillas ocurre con más frecuencia en la ciudad de Belice, sobre todo al sur de Haulover Creek (Southside).
safety.quote: Serious gang-related violence occurs most frequently in Belize City, particularly in the area to the south of the Haulover Creek (known as Southside).

safety.en: Tourists are generally vulnerable to theft of cash, cards, phones and belongings, including in San Pedro, Caye Caulker, Placencia and San Ignacio.
safety.es: Los turistas son vulnerables al robo de efectivo, tarjetas, teléfonos y pertenencias, también en San Pedro, Caye Caulker, Placencia y San Ignacio.
safety.quote: Tourists, in general, are vulnerable to theft of cash, credit cards, phones and other personal belongings, including in tourist destinations such as San Pedro, Caye Caulker, Placencia and San Ignacio.

safety.en: Only take registered taxis with green licence plates, ask the fare before getting in and expect to pay in cash.
safety.es: Toma solo taxis registrados con placas verdes, pregunta la tarifa antes de subir y espera pagar en efectivo.
safety.quote: Only take registered taxis with green licence plates. Always ask the fare before getting in, and expect to pay in cash.

safety.en: The hurricane season is from 1 June to 30 November.
safety.es: La temporada de huracanes va del 1 de junio al 30 de noviembre.
safety.quote: The hurricane season is from 1 June to 30 November.

safety.en: Road traffic accidents are common and local driving and vehicle maintenance standards are poor.
safety.es: Los accidentes de tráfico son comunes y los estándares locales de conducción y mantenimiento de vehículos son deficientes.
safety.quote: Road traffic accidents are common. Local driving and vehicle maintenance standards are poor.

health.en: Medical facilities are limited, prescription medicine is unreliable, and serious cases are normally evacuated to the US at the patient’s expense.
health.es: Los centros médicos son limitados, los medicamentos con receta no están garantizados y los casos graves suelen evacuarse a EE. UU. a cargo del paciente.
health.quote: Medical facilities in Belize are limited and availability of prescription medicine is unreliable. Serious medical cases are normally evacuated to the US, at the patient’s expense.

health.en: Bottled water is a must in most areas.
health.es: El agua embotellada es imprescindible en la mayoría de las zonas.
health.quote: Bottled water is a must in most areas.

health.en: The WHO declared Belize malaria-free in 2023, and anti-malarial drugs are no longer recommended.
health.es: La OMS declaró a Belice libre de malaria en 2023 y ya no se recomiendan fármacos antipalúdicos.
health.quote: The WHO declared Belize malaria-free in 2023, and anti-malarial drugs are no longer recommended.

health.en: Dengue fever and Zika are both risks in Belize.
health.es: El dengue y el zika son riesgos en Belice.
health.quote: Dengue fever and Zika are both risks in Belize.

health.en: Many places in Belize are very hot and humid, and dehydration is a risk.
health.es: Muchos lugares de Belice son muy cálidos y húmedos, y la deshidratación es un riesgo.
health.quote: Many places in Belize are very hot and humid, and dehydration is a risk.

help.en: The emergency numbers are 911 or 90 for ambulance, fire and police.
help.es: Los números de emergencia son el 911 o el 90 para ambulancia, bomberos y policía.

help.en: Call 911 and ask for an ambulance.
help.es: Llama al 911 y pide una ambulancia.
help.quote: Call 911 and ask for an ambulance.

getting_in.en: Philip S. W. Goldson International Airport (BZE) is in Ladyville, 15 km northwest of Belize City.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto internacional Philip S. W. Goldson (BZE) está en Ladyville, 15 km al noroeste de la ciudad de Belice.
getting_in.quote: Philip S. W. Goldson International Airport (BZE IATA) (in Ladyville, 15 km northwest of Belize City

getting_in.en: Land access is from Mexico via Chetumal, or on a much rougher road from Guatemala via Melchor de Mencos.
getting_in.es: Por tierra se entra desde México por Chetumal, o por un camino mucho más difícil desde Guatemala por Melchor de Mencos.
getting_in.quote: From Mexico via Chetumal, or on a much rougher road from Guatemala via Melchor de Mencos.

getting_in.en: Entering by land from Mexico, Mexican immigration charges M$533 (as of May 2018) unless you can show proof you paid the fee on entering Mexico.
getting_in.es: Al entrar por tierra desde México, migración mexicana cobra M$533 (a mayo de 2018) salvo que pruebes haber pagado la tarifa al ingresar a México.
getting_in.quote: If entering by land from Mexico, you will be charged a fee of M$533 (Mexican pesos) (as of May 2018) by Mexican immigration unless you can show proof that you paid the immigration fee when you entered Mexico.

getting_in.en: For a cheaper fare, consider flying to Cancun or Mérida and taking a bus to Belize City.
getting_in.es: Para un pasaje más barato, considera volar a Cancún o Mérida y tomar un autobús a la ciudad de Belice.
getting_in.quote: For a cheaper fare, consider flying to Cancun or Mérida and take a bus to Belize City from there.

getting_in.en: Small speedboats run daily between Puerto Barrios in Guatemala and Punta Gorda for around US$20 one way.
getting_in.es: Pequeñas lanchas rápidas operan a diario entre Puerto Barrios, en Guatemala, y Punta Gorda por unos 20 dólares estadounidenses por trayecto.
getting_in.quote: Small speedboats operate on a daily basis between Puerto Barrios in Guatemala to Punta Gorda, cost is around US$20 one way.

getting_in.en: Several cruise lines call on Belize City.
getting_in.es: Varias líneas de cruceros hacen escala en la ciudad de Belice.
getting_in.quote: Several cruise lines call on Belize City.

getting_around.en: Tropic Air and Maya Island Air have multiple daily flights to towns around the country and to Ambergris Caye and Caye Caulker.
getting_around.es: Tropic Air y Maya Island Air tienen varios vuelos diarios a distintas localidades del país y a Ambergris Caye y Caye Caulker.
getting_around.quote: Tropic Air and Maya Island Air both have multiple flights daily to various towns around the country and to Ambergris Caye and Caye Caulker.

getting_around.en: Several competing bus lines run north–south from Punta Gorda to Belmopan and Belize City.
getting_around.es: Varias líneas de autobuses compiten en la ruta norte-sur desde Punta Gorda hasta Belmopán y la ciudad de Belice.
getting_around.quote: Several competing bus lines operate on the main road in the north–south direction from Punta Gorda to Belmopan and Belize City.

getting_around.en: Bus fares run from BZ$2 to 25 depending on distance travelled.
getting_around.es: Las tarifas de autobús van de BZ$2 a 25 según la distancia recorrida.
getting_around.quote: Fares run anywhere from BZ$2–25 depending on distance travelled.

getting_around.en: Most taxis do not use meters, so negotiate the price beforehand.
getting_around.es: La mayoría de los taxis no usan taxímetro, así que negocia el precio de antemano.
getting_around.quote: Most taxis do not use meters, so be sure to negotiate the price beforehand.

getting_around.en: Water taxi from Belize City to San Pedro costs BZ$30 or US$15 one way and BZ$55 or US$27.50 round trip.
getting_around.es: El taxi acuático de la ciudad de Belice a San Pedro cuesta BZ$30 o US$15 de ida y BZ$55 o US$27.50 ida y vuelta.
getting_around.quote: Rates: Belize City to San Pedro or return: BZ$30 or US$15 (one way), BZ$55 or US$27.50 (round trip).

getting_around.en: Almost every road off the four major highways is unpaved, so a 4-wheel drive vehicle is advisable.
getting_around.es: Casi todos los caminos fuera de las cuatro carreteras principales no están pavimentados, por lo que se aconseja un vehículo 4x4.
getting_around.quote: Unfortunately, almost every road off the four major highways is unpaved, so a 4-wheel drive vehicle is advisable.

money.en: The currency of Belize is the dollar (BZD), divided into 100 cents.
money.es: La moneda de Belice es el dólar (BZD), dividido en 100 centavos.
money.quote: The currency of Belize is the dollar (ISO code BZD), divided into 100 cents.

money.en: The Belizean dollar has been fixed to the US dollar at BZ$2 = US$1 since 1978.
money.es: El dólar beliceño está fijado al dólar estadounidense en BZ$2 = US$1 desde 1978.
money.quote: has been fixed to the US dollar (USD) at a 2:1 ratio since 1978 (i.e. BZ$2 = US$1).

money.en: US dollars are widely accepted, but clarify which "dollars" you mean when negotiating prices.
money.es: Los dólares estadounidenses se aceptan ampliamente, pero aclara de qué "dólares" hablas al negociar precios.
money.quote: Because of this consistent exchange rate, US dollars are widely accepted, but you should be careful to clarify which "dollars" you're talking about when negotiating prices.

money.en: ATMs of three banks in Belize accept Mastercard: Belize Bank, Scotiabank and Atlantic Bank.
money.es: Los cajeros de tres bancos en Belice aceptan Mastercard: Belize Bank, Scotiabank y Atlantic Bank.
money.quote: Three banks' ATMs in Belize accept Mastercard: the Belize Bank, Scotiabank, and Atlantic Bank.

money.en: Atlantic Bank offers free cash withdrawals with Visa.
money.es: Atlantic Bank ofrece retiros de efectivo gratis con Visa.
money.quote: Atlantic Bank offers free cash withdrawals with Visa.

etiquette.en: It is good practice to begin any interaction, even a quick question, with eye contact and a genuinely pleasant greeting.
etiquette.es: Es buena costumbre iniciar cualquier interacción, incluso una pregunta rápida, con contacto visual y un saludo genuinamente amable.
etiquette.quote: so it's good practice to begin any social interaction, even to ask a quick question, with eye contact and a genuinely pleasant greeting.

etiquette.en: Maya communities can be a little more reserved at times.
etiquette.es: Las comunidades mayas pueden ser a veces algo más reservadas.
etiquette.quote: The Maya communities can be a little more reserved at times.

connectivity.en: As of Oct 2025, it is increasingly common for cafes and restaurants to offer wifi.
connectivity.es: A octubre de 2025, es cada vez más común que cafés y restaurantes ofrezcan wifi.
connectivity.quote: As of Oct 2025, it is increasingly common for cafes and restaurants to offer wifi service.

connectivity.en: Internet cafés can be found in larger tourist areas but are infrequent in rural areas.
connectivity.es: Hay cibercafés en las zonas turísticas más grandes, pero son poco frecuentes en zonas rurales.
connectivity.quote: Internet cafés can be found in larger tourist areas, but are infrequent in rural areas.
